 Differential Scanning Calorimeter - STARe System TGA/DSC 3+ (Mettler Toledo, Switzerland)
Differential Scanning Calorimeter - STARe System TGA/DSC 3+ (Mettler Toledo, Switzerland)
Description: The STARe System TGA/DSC 3+ is a highly advanced thermal analysis instrument that combines two key techniques: Thermogravimetric Analysis (TGA) and Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC). This system is used to study the thermal properties of materials by measuring changes in mass (TGA) and heat flow (DSC) as a function of temperature or time. The calorimeter has high measurement accuracy, sensitivity and flexibility, allowing for detailed analysis in fields such as material science, pharmaceuticals, polymers, and environmental research. It offers enhanced features like superior temperature control, high-resolution measurement, and easy integration with various accessories for customized applications.
Specifications:
Technique: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC); Thermogravimetry (TGA)
Data Sampling: 10 data pts/sec
Sensor Output: mass; heat flow
Temperature Range: 30 °C-1600 °C
Heating rate: from 0.02 to 100 °C/min, increment 0.01 °C/min
Temperature precision: ±0.3 °C, register signal of differential scanning calorimetry in automatic mode
Measurement range: 5 g
Min weight: 0.17 mg
Resolution: 0.1 μg over the entire range of weighing
Blank curve reproducibility: better than ±10 μg over the whole temperature range
Weighing accuracy: 0.005 %
Weighing precision: 0.0025 %
High precision temperature stabilization system of the cell with an electronic thermostat
Built-in automatic calibration with two built-in linearization weights
Possibility of calibration with external weight
